title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Tip-Reduction Buffer Schedule
content:
**Cartwise Shopper Payouts — tip-reduction buffer on catch-up deposits**

A tip-reduction buffer stays on the Cartwise Shopper Payouts balance when a catch-up deposit is sent: a shopper with two or more batch tip reductions in the last 3 months leaves 15.00, a shopper with exactly one leaves 7.50, and a shopper with none leaves nothing. The buffer is not part of the catch-up deposit.

| Batch tip reductions in the last 3 months | Buffer left on the balance |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 15.00 |
| Exactly one | 7.50 |
| None | Nothing |

**Records read.** A batch tip reduction is an entry on Cartwise Shopper Batches recording a reduction of the tip on one of the shopper's batches. "The last 3 months" counts the entries booked fewer than 3 whole months before the day of the catch-up; a tip reduction booked 3 whole months or more before that day is not counted.

**Hypothetical cases.**
- Two tip reductions, one booked 5 weeks and one 10 weeks before the catch-up: two in the window, buffer 15.00.
- One tip reduction 2 months before and another 4 months before: only one in the window, buffer 7.50.
- No tip reductions in the window: no buffer.
